name: Quest Representatives
description: Which AI representative holds each quest and handles each request, task and newly assigned goal.
purpose: Put each request in the hands of the representative that fits it.
approach: Choose by assignment, role, thread and the quests each representative holds, keep a thread's representative for the work it spawns, and ask the person only when two fit equally.
out_of_scope: What the representative does with the request; the hub's The Representatives owns the general seat.
milestones: 1. Assigned representatives, threads, reassignment and new-goal owners pass on labelled cases.
measures_of_success: On labelled requests the chosen representative matches the label, work spawned from a thread keeps its representative, and the person is asked only when two fit equally.
parameters: The roles, assignments and visibility of each representative.
inputs: A message, a queued task, a new goal or an autopilot pass, with the quest.
effects: None beyond recording who holds the work.
usage_notes: Reached by the host before the request is planned.
